queries: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_rating AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS avg_per_day_rate FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_replacement_cost, r.avg_per_day_rate, r.avg_per_day_rate - c.avg_per_day_rate AS above_cross_rating_average FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN cross_rating c WHERE r.avg_per_day_rate > c.avg_per_day_rate ORDER BY r.rating

WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS cross_rating_avg FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_replacement_cost, ra.avg_per_day_rate, ra.avg_per_day_rate - b.cross_rating_avg AS amount_above_cross_rating_avg FROM rating_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE ra.avg_per_day_rate > b.cross_rating_avg ORDER BY ra.rating
